new.name: Blue Winged Olive Parachute
new.description: A small olive parachute for the BWO hatch: easy to see and sits low like a dun.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it to risers on overcast spring and autumn days.
steps: Tie in the post and stand it up with thread wraps at its base.
Dub a slim, tapered body up to the post.
Tie in the hackle at the post and wind it down the post, 3–5 turns.
Tie off the hackle under the post, add a little dubbing in front and whip finish.

new.name: Hare's Ear Parachute
new.description: A buggy parachute with a rough hare's ear body: a great searching dry.
new.fishing_tips: Use it when there's no clear hatch.
steps: Tie in the post and stand it up with thread wraps at its base.
Dub a slim, tapered body up to the post.
Tie in the hackle at the post and wind it down the post, 3–5 turns.
Tie off the hackle under the post, add a little dubbing in front and whip finish.

new.name: Parachute Caddis
new.description: An elk-wing caddis with a parachute hackle around a sighter post: floats low and is easy to see.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it during caddis hatches on flat or riffled water.
steps: Tie in the elk wing with the post on top.
Wind the parachute hackle around the post.

new.name: Spotlight Caddis Emerger
new.description: A caddis emerger with a Z-Lon shuck, a dubbed body, a deer hair wing and a bright foam spotlight post.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in the film during caddis hatches.
steps: Tie in a short deer hair wing and a foam post on top.

new.name: Puterbaugh Caddis
new.description: A high-floating caddis with a foam body, an elk wing and a heavy hackle collar.
new.fishing_tips: Skate it in riffles in the evening.
steps: Lash a foam strip along the shank.
Wind a full hackle collar and whip finish.

new.name: Lawson's Caddis Emerger
new.description: A caddis emerger with a sparkle shuck, a dubbed body, a short deer hair wing and a hackle collar.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it just in the film.
steps: Add the wing and a sparse hackle, whip finish.

new.name: Wiggle Nymph
new.description: An articulated mayfly nymph: the abdomen is tied on a cut-off hook joined to the thorax so it wiggles.
new.fishing_tips: Swing or twitch it during mayfly emergences.
mats: Two nymph hooks (one cut off for the abdomen)
steps: Tie the abdomen on the first hook and cut off its bend.
Join it to the second hook with a wire loop.
Tie the thorax, wing case and legs on the second hook.

new.name: Rojo Midge
new.description: A red thread midge with a silver wire rib, a small white wing bud and a dark thorax.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it under an indicator in tailwaters.
steps: Wrap a red thread body and rib it.
Tie in a short white wing bud.
Dub a tiny thorax and whip finish.

new.name: Miracle Nymph
new.description: A simple white floss midge larva ribbed with copper wire, with a brown head.
new.fishing_tips: Dead-drift it in tailwaters.
steps: Make a small brown head and whip finish.

new.name: Blood Midge
new.description: A blood-red midge larva of thread and wire with a small dark head.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it deep in lakes and tailwaters.
steps: Make a dark head and whip finish.

new.name: Flashback Midge
new.description: A thread midge with a pearl flash back over the thorax.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it under an indicator.
steps: Wrap a slim thread body and rib it.
Wrap a peacock thorax and pull the flash over, whip finish.

new.name: Palomino Midge
new.description: A midge emerger with an extended Antron body, a dubbed thorax and a small white wing.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in the film during midge hatches.
steps: Twist and tie in the extended body.
Dub a small thorax and whip finish.

new.name: Craven's Baetis
new.description: A slim Baetis nymph with a biot or thread body, a flashback wing case and a tungsten bead.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it under an indicator before BWO hatches.
steps: Add the bead and tie in a short tail.
Tie in the wing case, dub the thorax and pull the case over.

new.name: Tung Teaser
new.description: A tiny tungsten-bead nymph with a pheasant tail body and a flash collar.
new.fishing_tips: Use it as a dropper in tailwaters.
steps: Dub a flash collar and whip finish.

new.name: Czech Nymph
new.description: A heavy, curved caddis-larva nymph: weighted body, dubbed segments, a shellback and a dark thorax.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it short-line in fast water.
steps: Tie in the shellback and rib.
Pull the shellback over, rib it and whip finish.

new.name: Rainbow Czech Nymph
new.description: A Czech nymph with a rainbow-coloured pearl shellback and a bright hot spot.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it short-line in fast water.
mats: Pearl or rainbow flash under Scud Back
Dubbing with a pink or orange hot spot
steps: Tie in the shellback and rib.
Dub the body with a hot spot.
Pull the shellback over and rib it.

new.name: Polish Woven Nymph
new.description: A woven-body caddis nymph with a dark back and a pale belly woven from floss or thread.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it deep in fast water.
steps: Weight the hook and build an underbody.
Weave the two floss colours along the shank.
Dub the thorax and whip finish.

new.name: Woven Stonefly
new.description: A realistic stonefly nymph with a woven two-tone body, biot tails, a turkey wing case and legs.
new.fishing_tips: Dead-drift it deep through riffles.
mats: Two colours of yarn or floss, woven
steps: Weight and flatten the shank, tie in biot tails.
Tie in wing cases and legs, dub the thorax.

new.name: Barr Emerger PMD
new.description: Barr's PMD emerger: a brown nymph body with a light dun hackle tied back and a wing case.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it just under the surface during PMD hatches.
mats: Light dun hackle fibres pulled over
steps: Tie in the tail and dub the abdomen.
Dub a yellow thorax and pull the fibres over, leaving legs each side.

new.name: PMD Cripple
new.description: A crippled PMD with a trailing shuck, a yellow body and a CDC or hackle wing that sits low.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it to fussy risers during PMD hatches.
steps: Tie in the wing and a sparse hackle, whip finish.

new.name: Mercer's Micro Mayfly
new.description: A tiny beaded mayfly nymph with a pheasant tail body, a flashback wing case and a peacock thorax.
new.fishing_tips: Use it as a dropper during Baetis and PMD hatches.
steps: Tie in the case, wrap the thorax, pull it over.

new.name: Iron Sally
new.description: A small yellow stonefly nymph with a tungsten bead and a dark back.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in riffles in summer.
steps: Add the bead and biot tails.
Tie in the wing case and legs, whip finish.

new.name: Hot Spot Pheasant Tail
new.description: A pheasant tail nymph with a fluorescent orange or pink collar.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it deep in riffles.
steps: Dub the hot collar and whip finish.

new.name: Pink Tag Jig
new.description: A jig nymph with a pink tag, a pheasant or dubbed body and a tungsten bead.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it on a Euro rig.
steps: Add the bead and a short pink tag.
Add a collar and whip finish.

new.name: Otter Egg
new.description: A realistic egg of a soft, pale dubbed ball with a dark eye spot.
new.fishing_tips: Dead-drift it below spawning fish.
mats: Otter's soft egg dubbing or yarn
steps: Trim it smooth, add an eye spot with a marker.

new.name: Estaz Egg
new.description: A fluffy egg of wrapped Estaz chenille.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it near spawning fish.

new.name: Conehead Woolly Bugger
new.description: The Woolly Bugger with a cone head so it dives and jigs.
new.fishing_tips: Strip and pause; it dips on every stop.
steps: Add the cone and tie in the tail.
Tie in the hackle and chenille, wrap the body.
Palmer the hackle and finish behind the cone.

new.name: Bucktail Streamer
new.description: A simple bucktail: silver body, white under brown or olive bucktail, with a little flash.
new.fishing_tips: Strip it for trout and bass.
steps: Tie in the white bucktail, flash, then the dark top.
Whip finish and coat the head.

new.name: Marabou Muddler
new.description: A Muddler with a marabou wing and a spun deer hair head.
new.fishing_tips: Strip or swing it; the marabou breathes.
steps: Tie in the tail and wrap the body.
Spin a deer hair collar and head, trim.

new.name: Black Marabou Streamer
new.description: A black marabou wing over a black chenille body with flash.
new.fishing_tips: Great in dirty water.
steps: Tie in the tail and wrap the body.
Tie in the wing and flash.

new.name: White Zonker
new.description: A white rabbit strip Zonker over a pearl body.
new.fishing_tips: Strip it for trout and bass on bright days.
steps: Cover the shank with Mylar tubing.
Tie the rabbit strip at the head and bend.
Wind a collar and whip finish.

new.name: Olive Zonker
new.description: An olive rabbit strip Zonker over a gold or pearl body.
new.fishing_tips: Strip it near cover.
steps: Tie the rabbit strip at head and bend.

new.name: Kiwi Muddler
new.description: A rabbit strip Matuka-style streamer with a spun deer hair head.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it deep for big trout.
steps: Tie the rabbit strip along the top with the rib.

new.name: Clouser Deep Minnow
new.description: The original Clouser Deep Minnow: dumbbell eyes, white bucktail under, a little flash and a darker bucktail top.
new.fishing_tips: Strip it with pauses so it jigs; works for almost anything that eats baitfish.
steps: Tie the eyes on a third of the way back.
Tie white bucktail in front of the eyes and behind them.
Flip the hook, add flash and the back colour.
Whip finish and coat the head.

new.name: Chartreuse Clouser
new.description: The classic chartreuse and white Clouser.
new.fishing_tips: A top colour in stained water.
steps: Add flash and chartreuse on top.

new.name: Half and Half Clouser
new.description: A Clouser front with a Deceiver's saddle hackle tail for a bigger profile.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it for stripers and snook.
steps: Tie bucktail Clouser style over the tail.

new.name: Cinder Worm
new.description: A thin red and brown worm with a dark head, for spring cinder worm hatches.
new.fishing_tips: Swim it slowly near the surface at dusk in May and June.
steps: Make a dark head and whip finish.

new.name: Palolo Worm
new.description: A rusty orange worm with a dark head for the palolo worm hatch.
new.fishing_tips: Swing it slowly during worm hatches for tarpon.
steps: Add a dark head and whip finish.

new.name: Worm Hatch Fly
new.description: A simple worm fly of chenille and marabou for saltwater worm hatches.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it slow in the film.

new.name: Silverside
new.description: A slim, translucent baitfish with a silver stripe.
new.fishing_tips: Strip it fast where stripers and albies are on small bait.
mats: White and tan synthetic hair with a silver flash stripe
steps: Tie the wing with a silver stripe.
Add eyes and coat the head.

new.name: Bay Anchovy
new.description: A tiny anchovy imitation with a pearl body, sparse wing and a resin head.
new.fishing_tips: Strip it fast for false albacore.
mats: Sparse grey and white synthetic hair

new.name: Sand Lance
new.description: A long, skinny sand eel imitation.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it near sandy bottoms.
mats: Long, sparse synthetic hair, olive over white
steps: Add eyes and coat the head.

new.name: Mushmouth
new.description: A translucent baitfish of layered Polar Fibre and flash with a slim profile.
new.fishing_tips: Strip it for stripers and albies.
mats: Polar Fibre or Slinky Fibre, layered
steps: Tie in layers of fibre and flash.

new.name: Beast Fleye
new.description: A huge, light baitfish of hollow-tied bucktail for big stripers and bluefish.
new.fishing_tips: Throw it on a heavy rod near big bait.
steps: Hollow-tie bunches of bucktail along the shank.
Add eyes and coat the head.

new.name: Bucktail Jig Fly
new.description: A jig-style bucktail fly with a cone or bead head.
new.fishing_tips: Hop it along the bottom for fluke, stripers and redfish.
steps: Tie bucktail all around the hook.

new.name: Tarpon Snake
new.description: A long, slender tarpon fly of marabou and saddle hackles.
new.fishing_tips: Swim it slowly ahead of tarpon.

new.name: Black and Purple Tarpon
new.description: A dark tarpon fly of black and purple saddles with a marabou collar.
new.fishing_tips: A great colour in dark or stained water.

new.name: Pinfish Fly
new.description: A deep-bodied pinfish imitation with bars and a yellow tint.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it for snook, redfish and tarpon near grass.
mats: Layered synthetic fibres, tan and yellow
steps: Tie fibres in layers for a deep body.

new.name: Mullet Fly
new.description: A blunt-headed mullet of deer hair or synthetic fibres.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it around mullet schools.
mats: Spun deer hair or EP fibres, trimmed

new.name: Crab Fly
new.description: A simple crab: a yarn or foam body, rubber legs and weighted eyes.
new.fishing_tips: Drop it in front of redfish and permit.
steps: Tie on the eyes and claws.
Build the body and trim it round.

new.name: Bonefish Shrimp
new.description: A simple shrimp: bead chain eyes, a craft fur wing and a palmered body.
new.fishing_tips: Strip it in short hops.

new.name: Christmas Island Special
new.description: A bright orange and pearl bonefish fly.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it on Pacific flats for bonefish and trevally.

new.name: Foam Diver
new.description: A foam-headed diver that dives and pops back up.
new.fishing_tips: Strip it to dive, pause to let it float.

new.name: Deer Hair Diver
new.description: A spun deer hair diver with a collar that makes it dive and wobble.
new.fishing_tips: Strip it hard; pause to let it rise.
mats: Spun deer hair trimmed to a diving lip
steps: Spin hair for the collar and head.
Trim a flat diving face and add a weed guard.

new.name: Swimming Frog
new.description: A frog with kicking rubber or hair legs and a foam or deer hair body.
new.fishing_tips: Twitch it over lily pads.
steps: Add the eyes and a weed guard.

new.name: Wiggle Bug
new.description: A small bug with a foam head and a long, wiggling tail.
new.fishing_tips: Twitch it for bass and big bluegill.

new.name: Pencil Popper
new.description: A long, slim popper that walks and pops.
new.fishing_tips: Walk it for bass and stripers.

new.name: Bass Bug Hair
new.description: A spun deer hair bass bug with a hackle tail and hair collar.
new.fishing_tips: Pop and pause it along banks.

new.name: Deer Hair Popper
new.description: A spun deer hair popper with a flat face that pops when stripped.
new.fishing_tips: Pop it near weeds and wood.
mats: Spun deer hair, trimmed to a flat face

new.name: Rubber Spider
new.description: A chenille body with lots of rubber legs.
new.fishing_tips: Let it sink slowly near beds.

new.name: Panfish Spider
new.description: A foam or cork spider body with rubber legs that floats.
new.fishing_tips: Twitch it near cover.

new.name: Sponge Spider
new.description: A sponge-rubber body with rubber legs; the classic bluegill bug.
new.fishing_tips: Let it sit, then twitch it.

new.name: Crappie Candy
new.description: A small, flashy baitfish fly for crappie.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it slowly near brush.

new.name: Clouser Crappie
new.description: A small Clouser for crappie.
new.fishing_tips: Jig it near brush piles.

new.name: Marabou Jig Fly
new.description: A marabou jig on a jig hook with a bead head.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it under an indicator for crappie.

new.name: Bluegill Bully
new.description: A small weighted wet fly with a chenille body and soft hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Let it sink near beds.

new.name: Shad Dart
new.description: A weighted shad fly with a bright body and a short tail.
new.fishing_tips: Swing it deep through shad runs.

new.name: American Shad Fly
new.description: A simple bright shad fly of flash, bead chain eyes and a red head.
new.fishing_tips: Swing it during the spring shad run.
steps: Wrap the body and make a red head.

new.name: Carp Worm
new.description: A weighted worm fly for carp.
new.fishing_tips: Drop it near feeding carp.

new.name: Carp Clouser
new.description: A small, soft Clouser for carp.
new.fishing_tips: Drop it in front of feeding carp and twitch.

new.name: Mulberry Fly
new.description: A dark, round berry of dubbing or yarn for carp feeding under mulberry trees.
new.fishing_tips: Drop it under overhanging trees.

new.name: Bread Fly
new.description: A floating white foam or yarn imitation of bread.
new.fishing_tips: Float it where people feed bread to carp.
steps: Tie in the foam and trim it to a bread crust shape.

new.name: Pike Fly
new.description: A big, simple pike streamer of saddles and bucktail with eyes.
new.fishing_tips: Strip it with long pulls on a wire tippet.

new.name: Pike Deceiver
new.description: A Deceiver scaled up for pike.
new.fishing_tips: Strip it with pauses.
steps: Add a bucktail collar all round.

new.name: Bucktail Pike Fly
new.description: Layered bucktail in bright colours with flash and big eyes.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it on a wire tippet.

new.name: Flashtail Whistler
new.description: A Whistler with a flash tail, bead chain eyes and a palmered hackle collar that 'whistles' through the air.
new.fishing_tips: Strip it for pike, stripers and snook.
steps: Tie on the eyes and wrap the chenille.

new.name: Musky Bucktail
new.description: A huge bucktail fly for musky.
new.fishing_tips: Strip it hard and figure-eight at the boat.

new.name: Musky Fly
new.description: A big articulated musky fly of bucktail, saddles and flash.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it on heavy tackle.
mats: Two big hooks joined with wire
steps: Dress the front hook and add eyes.

new.name: Buford
new.description: A huge musky fly of bucktail and flash that pushes lots of water.
new.fishing_tips: Long strips and figure-eights for musky.
steps: Hollow-tie bucktail on the rear hook.
Hollow-tie bucktail on the front hook.

new.name: Brushy Fly
new.description: A pike fly built from a wrapped synthetic brush and trimmed to shape.
new.fishing_tips: Strip it for pike and bass.
steps: Trim to shape and add eyes.

new.name: Hang Time Fly
new.description: A pike fly built to suspend and hang, with a buoyant head.
new.fishing_tips: Strip and pause; it hangs in front of the fish.

new.name: Purple Spey
new.description: A purple Spey for steelhead: a long, flowing hackle over a purple body.
new.fishing_tips: Swing it slowly across and down for steelhead and salmon.
mats: Long purple schlappen or heron substitute
Bronze mallard or purple hen tips
steps: Tie in the rib and hackle at the rear.
Dub the body and wind the long hackle forward between the ribs.
Add a soft throat if you like.
Tie in the wing low over the body and whip finish.

new.name: Orange Heron
new.description: Syd Glasso's Northwest classic: an orange body, long grey heron hackle and orange hackle-tip wings.
new.fishing_tips: Swing it slowly across and down for steelhead and salmon.
steps: Tie in the rib and hackle at the rear.
Dub the body and wind the long hackle forward between the ribs.
Add a soft throat if you like.
Tie in the wing low over the body and whip finish.

new.name: Grey Heron
new.description: One of the original Spey flies: yellow and black body, long grey hackle and bronze mallard wings.
new.fishing_tips: Swing it slowly across and down for steelhead and salmon.
steps: Tie in the rib and hackle at the rear.
Dub the body and wind the long hackle forward between the ribs.
Add a soft throat if you like.
Tie in the wing low over the body and whip finish.

new.name: Marabou Spey
new.description: A Spey fly whose hackle is wound marabou, giving huge movement in slow water.
new.fishing_tips: Swing it slowly across and down for steelhead and salmon.
steps: Tie in the rib and hackle at the rear.
Dub the body and wind the long hackle forward between the ribs.
Add a soft throat if you like.
Tie in the wing low over the body and whip finish.

new.name: Popsicle
new.description: A marabou steelhead fly of orange, red and purple bands.
new.fishing_tips: Swing it in cold, coloured water.
mats: Bands of orange, red and purple marabou, wound
steps: Wind orange marabou at the rear.
Add red, then purple, with flash between.

new.name: Bunny Spey
new.description: A rabbit strip Spey fly: wound rabbit body with a soft hackle collar.
new.fishing_tips: Swing it on a sink-tip for winter steelhead.

new.name: Tube Fly Steelhead
new.description: A tube fly of marabou and flash with a separate hook, so the fly slides up the leader.
new.fishing_tips: Swing it for steelhead and salmon.
mats: Plastic or metal tube with a short hook
steps: Mount the tube on a needle.
Add a collar and whip finish.

new.name: Squirrel Leech
new.description: A squirrel zonker strip leech with a bead.
new.fishing_tips: Strip or dead-drift it.

new.name: Callibaetis Emerger
new.description: A lake mayfly emerger with a shuck, a speckled body and a CDC wing.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in the film on calm lakes.
steps: Tie in a CDC wing and whip finish.

new.name: Chironomid Emerger
new.description: A chironomid with a thread body, a shuck and a white puff that holds it in the film.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it static in the film.

new.name: Red Buzzer
new.description: A slim, coated red buzzer with a fine rib and orange or white cheeks.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it slowly on a floating line or under an indicator.
steps: Wrap a slim tapered thread body.
Tie in cheeks at the thorax.

new.name: Black Buzzer
new.description: A slim, coated black buzzer with a fine rib and orange or white cheeks.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it slowly on a floating line or under an indicator.
steps: Wrap a slim tapered thread body.
Tie in cheeks at the thorax.

new.name: Hare's Ear Buzzer
new.description: A buzzer with a hare's ear thorax and a ribbed thread body.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it slowly near the surface.

new.name: Shuttlecock Buzzer
new.description: A buzzer hanging from a CDC 'shuttlecock' wing in the film.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it static during buzzer hatches.
mats: CDC tied forward over the eye
steps: Tie in CDC over the eye as a shuttlecock.

new.name: CDC Shuttlecock
new.description: A CDC shuttlecock emerger for river and lake hatches.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it to risers during hatches.

new.name: Hopper Black
new.description: A black seal fur hopper with knotted pheasant legs.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it static in a ripple.
mats: Black seal fur ribbed with pearl

new.name: Claret Hopper
new.description: A claret seal fur hopper with knotted pheasant legs.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it on the surface during hatches.
mats: Claret seal fur ribbed with gold

new.name: Bob's Bits
new.description: A simple stillwater dry of seal fur with a white wing and a hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it during buzzer hatches.

new.name: Adams Irresistible
new.description: An Adams with a spun and clipped deer hair body: floats in rough water.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in pocket water.
steps: Spin and clip a deer hair body.
Tie in the wings and wind the hackle.

new.name: Royal Humpy
new.description: A Humpy with a red floss body under a deer hair hump and white calf wings.
new.fishing_tips: A buoyant attractor for fast water.
mats: Red floss with deer hair hump
steps: Tie in the tail and hump hair.
Wrap the body, pull the hump over.
Stand up the wings, add calf and wind the hackle.

new.name: Yellow Humpy
new.description: The Humpy with a yellow thread body.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in fast water.
mats: Yellow thread under a deer hair hump
steps: Tie in the tail and hump hair.
Wrap the body and pull the hump over.
Stand the tips up as wings and wind the hackle.

new.name: Wood Special
new.description: A Maine smelt streamer with a silver body and grizzly and white hackle wing.
new.fishing_tips: Troll or strip it after ice-out.

new.name: Joe's Smelt
new.description: A simple smelt streamer of silver Mylar body and mallard flank wing.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it for landlocked salmon in spring.

new.name: Barnes Special
new.description: A red and white bucktail with yellow and grizzly hackles and a silver body.
new.fishing_tips: Troll it for landlocks and brook trout.
mats: Red over white bucktail with yellow and grizzly hackles

new.name: Magog Smelt
new.description: A smelt bucktail with layered white, yellow, violet and peacock herl.
new.fishing_tips: Troll or strip it in spring.
mats: White, yellow, violet bucktail with peacock herl

new.name: Prince Jig
new.description: The Prince Nymph on a jig hook with a tungsten bead.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it on a Euro rig.
steps: Add the bead and biot tails.
Add a hackle and white biot wings.

new.name: Desert Storm
new.description: A tan-and-flash midge/mayfly nymph with a tungsten bead.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in tailwaters.
mats: Tan thread ribbed with fine wire

new.name: Brassie Red
new.description: A Brassie with a red copper wire body and a peacock head.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it deep in tailwaters.

new.name: Rainbow Scud
new.description: A rainbow pearl scud with a clear shellback and a picked-out dubbing body.
new.fishing_tips: Dead-drift it in weedy tailwaters and spring creeks.
steps: Tie in the shellback and rib.
Pull the shellback over and rib it.

new.name: Pink Scud
new.description: A pink scud with a clear shellback and a picked-out dubbing body.
new.fishing_tips: Dead-drift it in weedy tailwaters and spring creeks.
steps: Tie in the shellback and rib.
Pull the shellback over and rib it.

new.name: Orange Scud
new.description: A orange scud with a clear shellback and a picked-out dubbing body.
new.fishing_tips: Dead-drift it in weedy tailwaters and spring creeks.
steps: Tie in the shellback and rib.
Pull the shellback over and rib it.

new.name: Gammarus
new.description: A realistic freshwater shrimp with a segmented back and antennae.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it deep in rivers and lakes.
steps: Tie in the shellback and rib.
Dub the body, pull the back over and rib.

new.name: Hydropsyche Larva
new.description: A realistic net-spinning caddis larva with a tan back, olive belly and dark head.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it deep in riffles.
steps: Add the bead, tie in the back.
Dub the body and pull the back over.
Add legs and a dark head.

new.name: Rhyacophila Larva
new.description: A bright green free-living caddis larva with a dark head.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it deep in fast water.

new.name: Peacock Caddis
new.description: A beaded caddis pupa with a peacock herl body and a soft hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Dead-drift or swing it.
steps: Wrap and rib a herl body.

new.name: Soft Hackle Caddis
new.description: A caddis-coloured soft hackle with a dubbed body and partridge hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Swing it during caddis hatches.

new.name: Bead Head Caddis Pupa

steps: Add legs and a dark head.

new.name: Partridge and Peacock
new.description: A peacock herl body and a partridge hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Fish a team of spiders upstream or across and down.
steps: Wrap or dub a slim body.
Wind one or two turns of the hackle.
